notes.title: Griptape Backbone now has Steam Controller Support!
notes.content:
While it'll still display the keyboard and mouse controls in the tutorial, there is now support for the Steam Controller gamepad!

You'll find the binding on recommended bindings tab when viewing the game's controller settings in Big Picture mode. Just select it, apply, and take a mental note of the controls listed. It's my own personal preference, so you can tweak it for yourself for the best experience. Regardless, this is a great way to double down on the relaxation factor of the game. So kick back, relax, and skate into a vaporwave extistential epiphany from your couch! Or bed... Or anywhere really. The limits are endless!

notes.title: Griptape Backbone is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28506447/19fb5ea8a515aaeba7b334d1a04ec54079c161da.jpg[/img]

Thank you so much those who voted YES and got this weird game on Steam. Griptape Backbone may not be a follow up to Awkward Dimensions Redux, but I'm proud of it anyways. Hopefully I sparked some interest in vaporwave to those who haven't been exposed to it prior and maybe even brought some life to the genre or helped define it further. I will be patching the game from the bug reports I get in the discussion board threads, thank you all so much. Have a good Cinco De Mayo everyone! Hope you all get something out of the game!
